ios.desc:
Overview
CoordTool is a professional coordinate converter for pilots, military, surveyors, and outdoor professionals. Convert between all major systems, use the global VOR/NDB database, and work fully offline with complete privacy.

Key Features
• Convert DD, DDM, DMS, UTM (WGS84/NAD27), MGRS, SWEREF 99, and RT90.
• Aviation support with global VOR/NDB station lookup.
• Interactive map with pin placement and live coordinates.
• Copy all formats at once for quick sharing.
• Works 100% offline – no account, no subscription.
• 7-day free trial, then one-time Pro unlock.
• Available in 5 languages (English, Swedish, German, French, Spanish).

Privacy
Your data stays private. CoordTool never collects or shares personal information. All processing is done locally on your device. Location access is only used to show your position on the map and is never transmitted.

CoordTool is built for professional users who need accurate, offline coordinate conversions and aviation navigation tools.

quotes.text:
I built an iOS app for accurate offline coordinate conversion. It’s meant for anyone who works with coordinates in the field – outdoor users, professionals, military, or pilots.

Key features:
• Convert between DD, DDM, DMS, UTM, MGRS, SWEREF99, RT90, and Plus Codes
• Fully offline – no account, no tracking, no subscription
• Built-in global VOR/NDB database
• Interactive map with pin placement
• Multilingual support (English, Spanish, German, French, Swedish)
• Dark/light mode toggle

Privacy was important to me: all processing is done locally on-device. Location is only used (if enabled) to fetch your GPS position and is never sent anywhere.

I’d love to hear your feedback, especially what features you’d like to see added or improved.
